items.name: Sandy Beach
items.description: Warm sand with gentle waves in the distance
items.adjustment: Shrink all four decorative seashells on the sand drastically: the large orange spiral shell on the lower left, the small pink scallop beside it, the large cream scallop at lower right, and the orange cone shell beside it. Each shell should be only 20–25% of its present width and height. At 1536px output, the largest shell must be at most 35–45px wide (about 2–3% of the canvas), most 20–30px. Keep their simple recognizable shapes and approximate locations close to the same side rocks. Replace the area exposed by shrinking with matching sand. Keep the large gray shoreline rocks and shrub clumps at their present scale.

items.name: Flower Field
items.description: A colorful field dotted with wildflowers
items.adjustment: Reduce the individual flower heads throughout the foreground and side flower beds to about 30% of their present diameter; maximum bloom diameter 25–40px on a 1536px canvas (about 2–2.6% of its width), and smaller in the distance. Keep the same flower colors and the flower-field identity, with small grouped blossoms among the existing green foliage. Avoid giant flower disks comparable to a creature head. Keep trees, foliage masses, rocks, hills, and central ground in place.

items.name: Pond Side
items.description: A muddy bank beside a still pond
items.adjustment: Reduce the pond's individual lily pads to roughly 35% of their present width, and the white water-lily blossoms to about 35% of their present size. On a 1536px canvas, near lily pads should generally be 35–55px wide, maximum 65px, while blossoms should be 18–30px wide. Keep them floating in their existing side groups, with unobstructed water between. Restore exposed water in the same color. Preserve the shoreline, rocks, trees, and cattail/reed clumps.

items.name: Lotus Lake
items.description: Pink lotus flowers rising above calm green water
items.adjustment: Shrink the huge pink lotus flowers and buds at the near side edges to about 30% of their present width and height. Largest bloom should be about 35–50px across on a 1536px canvas; distant blooms smaller. Reduce the large individual floating lotus/lily leaves to 35–40% of current size, generally 40–65px wide. Keep blossoms and pads grouped naturally along the same sides with clear water between. Preserve the lake shape, shore, trees, rocks and central standing ground.

items.name: Glass Beach
items.description: A shore of smooth, colorful sea glass
items.adjustment: Replace the oversized glossy sea-glass boulders at the left and right edges and bottom corners with small ordinary smooth sea-glass pebbles. Every colored sea-glass piece should be about 15–35px long on a 1536px canvas, at most 2–2.3% of the canvas width, much smaller than the creature's head. Retain their aqua, mint, amber and lavender colors in sparse low clusters or patches along the same edges; use a few dozen simple pebbles, not noisy hundreds of detailed beads. Restore sand and keep the normal large gray coastal rocks/cliffs, ocean, shoreline and horizon unchanged. Do not simply shrink the whole scene.

items.name: Celestial Garden
items.description: A garden floating among the stars, blooming eternally
items.adjustment: Reduce individual pink, lavender and white flower heads in the side garden beds to 25–30% of their current diameter. Typical blooms 20–35px, max 40px across on a 1536px canvas. Reduce the detached pink petals scattered on the path to 20–30% of their present size, usually 8–16px long. Keep a few grouped small flowers to retain the garden colors. Preserve the garden architecture, planters, foliage masses, cosmic sky and clear stone walkway.

items.name: Dragon's Hoard
items.description: A vast cavern heaped with gold and jewels
items.adjustment: Make the loose gold coins on the foreground floor small coin-sized details, about 15–20% of their present diameter, generally 8–16px across on a 1536px canvas. Reduce the huge individual red/blue/green cut gemstones at the foreground sides to about 15–20% of their present dimensions, typically 20–40px and max 50px. Preserve the overall large gold-heap silhouettes and existing treasure chests, but render the heaps as broad gold color masses with only sparse tiny coin marks so individual coins are not giant disks. Fill former gem footprints with matching gold/smooth cave floor. Keep cavern, lighting, layout and center open.

items.name: Bioluminescent Cavern
items.description: Glowing mushrooms and blue pools deep underground
items.adjustment: Reduce the large individual glowing cyan mushrooms near the foreground cave walls to about 30–35% of their present width and height. At 1536px, caps should generally be 25–45px wide, maximum 50px, with stems proportionally short. Keep small restrained mushroom clusters in approximately the same wall-side locations, and preserve their cyan glow colors. Restore the exposed rock surfaces. Keep the cavern, rock formations, blue pools and open floor unchanged. These are modest glowing mushrooms, not the giant tree-scale landmarks of Mushroom Forest.

items.name: Hanging Gardens

items.adjustment: Shrink individual pink flower heads on the vines and near lower edges to about 35–40% of their present diameter, typically 20–35px and maximum 40px across on a 1536px canvas. Preserve the broad vine and green foliage masses, terraces, stone arches, background waterfalls and open walkway. Make flowers small accents distributed through the existing greenery, not large disks.

items.name: Monarch Grove
items.description: Trees blanketed in thousands of orange butterflies
items.adjustment: Shrink all distinct individual orange-and-black monarch butterflies, including the large ones on the nearest trunks/branches and at bottom side corners, to roughly 25–30% of present wingspan. Typical wingspan 15–25px, maximum 30px on a 1536px canvas; airborne distant butterflies smaller. Keep the orange butterfly-covered grove effect by using grouped patches of tiny simple orange butterfly silhouettes with a few readable black wing marks, not oversized insects or fine noisy detail. Preserve trees, ordinary small flowers, green shrubs, background and central clearing.

reviewNotes: Reviewed all 80 current backgrounds at approximately the screenshot's creature-to-background scale. Landscape features and explicitly oversized fantasy landmarks (Mushroom Forest, World Tree, Titan's Graveyard, crystals, cliffs, coral and mature vegetation) retain their intended scale. Correct ordinary decorative props that dominate the creature.
